Exercise: Runner's Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- flexion
- extension_of_the_hip
- knee_joints

Primary Muscles:

- hamstrings

Secondary Muscles:

- calves

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- relieve_muscle_tension_in_the_lower_back
- improve_flexibility_of_the_hamstrings_and_hip_flexors

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Deep Lunge Stretch, id: Deep_Lunge_Stretch

Substitution Options:

- name: Seated Forward Bend, id: Seated_Forward_Bend

Instructions:

- It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start standing up, put one leg behind you, and slowly lower your torso down to the floor.
- Keep the front heel on the floor (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).
- Place your hands on either side of your front leg. To get more out of this stretch, push your butt up toward the ceiling, and then gradually lower it back toward the floor. You'll Stretch the hip flexor of the back leg and the hamstring and buttocks of the front.
